title: EMBER Internal Standard Schema v1 - Microgravity Combustion Test Run
description: One row = one combustion test run. Every adapter (proxy data today, official NASA data on Nov 14) MUST emit records that validate against this schema. Unknown source columns go into extra_telemetry - never drop them, never add new top-level fields without bumping the schema version.

experiment_id.description: Unique test run id. Proxy data uses EXP-0001..; official ids are kept verbatim.

gravity_g.description: Gravity level in Earth g. Canonical values: 0.0 (microgravity), 0.16 (Lunar), 0.38 (Mars), 1.0 (Earth).

oxygen_pct.description: Ambient O2 mole fraction in percent.

flow_velocity_cm_s.description: Imposed (forced) flow velocity in cm/s - stands in for cabin HVAC ventilation.

spread_or_burn_rate.description: Flame spread rate in mm/s for solids; d^2-law burning-rate constant K in mm^2/s for droplets/gaseous.

peak_radiative_flux_kw_m2.description: Peak radiometer heat flux in kW/m^2.

limiting_oxygen_index_pct.description: Minimum O2 % that supports burning at this condition.

source_doc_id.description: Provenance: document the values were extracted from (diagram: 'source doc + page per field').

extra_telemetry.description: Escape hatch. Any column not mapped to a field above lands here and is rendered generically in the UI.
